definition: תַּלְתִּי adjective denominative (only Biblical Aramaic) as substantive third (ruler), i.e. triumuir ( M 89* ), compare foregoing, which possibly is abnormal form of same ( K § 65, 1, Anm.3 ), Dan 5:7 .
